description: Run rule-based risk checks on a pull request: possible secrets in added lines (masked), sensitive files, large diffs, source changes without tests, CI workflow, migration and dependency changes, and leftover debug code. Returns an overall level (none/low/medium/high) and findings with file and line where possible. These are heuristics: confirm each finding by reading the code with get_pr_diff before reporting it.
name: check_pr_risk
title: Check pull request risk
